code:
Scripted REST API                 Import Sets
- external system calls IN         - staging tables + Transform Map
- JSON over HTTP POST              - batch files, e.g. nightly CSV
- near real time                   - fits systems with no API access
caption: Same direction, two mechanisms — pick by capability and timing.

code:
REST Message
- reusable endpoint definition
- URL, headers, auth, named HTTP methods
- invoked from a Business Rule, Script Include, or Flow
caption: An approved Change calling a deployment tool is a REST Message in action.

code:
REST Message                        Spoke action
- hand-written HTTP details     ->   - drag-and-drop in Flow Designer
- called from one script             - reusable across many flows
                                      - wraps one or more REST Messages
caption: IntegrationHub doesn't replace REST Messages — it packages them.
